AICG3D PoseSwap → Qwen2.1 姿态换姿生成
widgets_values: Reproduce the EXACT pose, limb angles, body orientation and camera viewpoint shown in image1 as faithfully as possible. image1 is the only source for the pose, skeletal structure and body proportions of the figure; copy it precisely. image2 is the only source for the person's identity: keep the EXACT same person, same face, same hairstyle, same clothing with all colors, fabric, patterns, accessories and shoes unchanged, same background and same lighting as in image2. Do NOT alter, replace, remove, recolor or redraw the outfit from image2; do not change the person or their style. Do not copy the line drawing, mannequin shape, or any annotations from image1.

nodes.title: AICG3D PoseSwap → Qwen Edit 2511 换装生成
widgets_values: You are a professional fashion virtual try-on assistant. Dress the person in image1 wearing the exact garment shown in image2, and output a single photorealistic full-body or half-body photo. Strict requirements: 1. Keep the person's identity EXACTLY the same: same face, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, body type and proportions. Do not change who they are. 2. Keep the person's original pose, body angle and orientation as much as possible; only adjust arms/limbs if strictly needed to fit the garment naturally. 3. Put the exact garment from image2 onto the person: preserve its color, fabric texture, pattern, neckline, sleeve length, hem length and silhouette faithfully. Do not redesign or simplify the garment. 4. The garment must drape naturally on the body and cast realistic folds, shadows and highlights consistent with the original lighting. 5. Keep the original background, lighting and overall mood of the person's photo. 6. Photorealistic, high detail, professional fashion editorial quality, 8k, natural skin texture. Output ONLY the final dressed-up photograph, nothing else.
